pairs.difference: A Taco is an open, folded shell you eat in two bites; a Burrito is a fully wrapped, heavy roll.
Spaghetti is long strands you twirl; Penne is short tubes you spear.
White sauce is creamy and cheesy; red sauce is tangy tomato.
Lasagne is flat sheets layered with sauce and baked; Mac and Cheese is small macaroni in a cheese sauce.
Bruschetta is toast topped with chopped tomato; Garlic Bread is buttered with garlic and often cheese, no topping.
Both are cabbage. Kimchi is Korean, fermented and spicy red; Coleslaw is creamy white with mayo.
Scrambled Eggs are stirred into curds; Sunny Side Up is fried whole with the yolk on top.
Chicken Wings are on the bone, saucy and messy; Chicken Nuggets are boneless, breaded, processed bites.
Sushi comes with rice; Sashimi is just slices of raw fish.
Dim Sum are steamed, soft dumplings in a basket; a Spring Roll is a long, crispy fried roll.
Meatballs are round, often in tomato sauce with spaghetti; a Sausage is a long tube, grilled or at breakfast.
Shawarma is meat shaved off a rotating spit; Falafel is fried chickpea balls.
Nachos are loose chips under melted cheese; a Quesadilla is a tortilla folded around cheese and grilled.
French Fries are potato sticks; Onion Rings are battered rings of onion.
A Hash Brown is a crisp fried patty; Mashed Potato is soft and scooped.
Fish and Chips is battered fish with fries, British; Fried Chicken is crispy chicken pieces, the KFC kind.
Ramen is Japanese noodles in broth; Pad Thai is Thai stir-fried noodles with peanuts.
Both are Thai or South-East Asian, with peanut and coconut flavours. Thai Curry is a coconut gravy with rice; Satay is grilled skewers with peanut sauce.
Caesar has lettuce, croutons and a creamy dressing; Greek has feta, olives and cucumber.
Pita is a thick pocket bread from the Middle East; a Tortilla is thin, flat and Mexican.
A Panini is a single layer of Italian bread, pressed and grilled; a Club Sandwich is triple-decker toast cut into triangles.
Pizza is round and sliced; a Burger is a stacked bun with a patty.
Hummus is beige and made from chickpeas; Guacamole is green and made from avocado.
A Croissant is a flaky, buttery crescent; a Bagel is a dense, chewy ring.
Soup is a hot liquid starter eaten with a spoon; Steak is a thick slab of grilled meat eaten with a knife.
A Barbecue grills meat and veg over coals; a Buffet is a spread of many dishes you serve yourself.
Ketchup is red and sweet; Mustard is yellow and sharp.
Salsa is chunky, made of tomato and spicy; Mayonnaise is smooth, white and creamy.
Cornflakes are crisp flakes eaten cold; Oats are cooked into a warm porridge.
